firmwares.name: OpenPocket
firmwares.what: A guitar multi-effects firmware: a chain of 12 blocks with amps, cabinets and effects in presets, neural amp models (NAM), and a preset editor in the browser.
A stereo effects instrument: twenty effects in four modules that can be put in any order.
firmwares.note: PALETTE has passed its tests on a simulated pedal only. It has not run on a real pedal yet.
